schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    PRODUCT_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    UNIT_PRICE INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (UNIT_PRICE > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE SALES (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    SELLER_ID INT,
    BUYER_ID INT,
    SALE_DATE DATE,
    QUANTITY INT,
    PRICE INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (PRODUCT_ID) REFERENCES PRODUCT(PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0),
    CHECK (PRICE > 0)
);
q1: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2: SELECT DISTINCT P.PRODUCT_ID,PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN SALES S ON P.PRODUCT_ID=S.PRODUCT_ID WHERE S.SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT PP INNER JOIN SALES SS ON PP.PRODUCT_ID=SS.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SS.SALE_DATE NOT BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND P.PRODUCT_ID=PP.PRODUCT_ID)
